FEAT4-ST-001.title: Define Provider Detail Schema and Contract
FEAT4-ST-001.description: Define Pydantic models and response contract for provider detail lookup including NPI, name, specialties, address, and external links.

FEAT4-ST-002.title: Implement Provider Detail Retrieval via NPI Registry
FEAT4-ST-002.description: Implement core service logic to call CMS NPI Registry API, parse response, and normalize provider attributes.

FEAT4-ST-003.title: Expose Provider Detail Lookup via Evaluate Care Facade
FEAT4-ST-003.description: Integrate provider detail service into evaluate_care_facade and register tool routing for LLM access.

FEAT4-ST-004.title: Enrich Provider Details with External Links
FEAT4-ST-004.description: Add logic to construct and attach state medical board links and research site URLs to provider detail responses.

FEAT4-ST-005.title: Test Provider Detail Lookup Service
FEAT4-ST-005.description: Create unit and integration tests covering NPI lookup, response normalization, error handling, and external link enrichment.
